description: Control EFI firmware boot settings and manage boot loaders.

tip: Remove unreferenced files belonging to the entry token.

tip: Install systemd-boot into the EFI System Partition.

tip: Check whether systemd-boot is installed.

tip: Identify the type of a kernel image.

tip: Print details about a kernel image.

tip: List available boot loader entries.

tip: Generate and store a random seed in the EFI System Partition.

tip: Query or set the Reboot-Into-Firmware-Setup flag.

tip: Remove systemd-boot from the EFI System Partition.

tip: Set the default boot loader entry.

option.name: --all-architectures
tip: Install binaries for all supported EFI architectures.

option.name: --boot-path
tip: Path to the $BOOT partition.

option.name: --certificate
tip: Certificate included in the secure boot signature databases.

option.name: --certificate-source
tip: OpenSSL provider for the certificate.

option.name: --dry-run
tip: Only print the files that would be deleted.

option.name: --efi-boot-option-description
tip: Description of the firmware boot option.

option.name: --entry-token
tip: Control how boot loader entries are named.
Possible values: auto, machine-id, os-id, os-image-id
Use literal:TEXT for an arbitrary token.

option.name: --esp-path
tip: Path to the EFI System Partition.

option.name: --graceful
tip: Ignore certain failures.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --image
tip: Operate on the filesystem in this disk image.

option.name: --image-policy
tip: Specify the disk image dissection policy.

option.name: --install-source
tip: Select where to source binaries when installing.
Possible values: auto, image, host

option.name: --json
tip: Generate JSON output.
Possible values: pretty, short, off

option.name: --make-entry-directory
tip: Control creation of the entry directory.
Possible values: yes, no

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --no-variables
tip: Do not touch the firmware boot loader list in EFI variables.

option.name: --print-boot-path
tip: Only print the path to the Extended Boot Loader partition.

option.name: --print-esp-path
tip: Only print the path to the EFI System Partition.

option.name: --print-loader-path
tip: Print the absolute path to the boot loader EFI binary.

option.name: --print-root-device
tip: Print the block device backing the root filesystem.

option.name: --print-stub-path
tip: Print the absolute path to the UKI/stub EFI binary.

option.name: --private-key
tip: Private key used to sign the EFI signature lists.

option.name: --private-key-source
tip: OpenSSL provider or engine for the private key.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress command results and ESP hints.

option.name: --random-seed
tip: Control random seed initialization during install.
Possible values: yes, no

option.name: --root
tip: Prefix all paths with this alternate root.

option.name: --secure-boot-auto-enroll
tip: Configure secure boot auto-enrollment during install.
Possible values: yes, no

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.
